name: Itsycal
description: The reviewed Itsycal macOS target enables scheduled Sparkle checks, points to its S3 appcast, and embeds SUPublicEDKey. Its preferences bind the automatic-check setting to SUUpdater.sharedUpdater; the source therefore supports a configured Sparkle EdDSA trust key, with framework enforcement and released artifacts outside this snapshot.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than historical release re-verification; Sparkle framework enforcement, appcast contents, and released artifact signatures were not independently audited.
